apps.name: Fluxa
apps.subtitle: Your media, in one place.
apps.versionDescription:
## What's Changed

- fix(plugins): keep reqwest for plugin requests on iOS, tvOS and webOS (`3de52145`)
- fix(plugins): send plugin requests through wreq with Chrome TLS emulation (`9c08a4f2`)
- fix(android): retry Cloudflare-blocked plugin requests through OkHttp (`08ec93e4`)
- fix(mobile): keep the stream picker backdrop to the episode hero and scroll the add-on chips (`0a3f2964`)
- feat(ui): show the app shell with placeholder rows while home catalogs load (`29f15684`)
- perf(home): load each home row as its own effect so rows appear as feeds answer (`73927522`)
- perf(home): cap first-paint network waits and keep the feeds that finished (`5f5eac46`)
- perf(desktop): start GPU init before the session and open the window on the first frame (`622c3645`)
- perf(desktop): prefer the low-power GPU so startup skips the discrete driver (`edbc2af8`)
- fix(home): show the cached home on startup instead of forcing a network reload (`f1f84bd6`)
- perf(desktop): read media servers from storage only when stale instead of every projection (`206c81dd`)
- perf(desktop): stop redrawing every frame while idle (`e673ee40`)
- feat(search): stream results per catalog with a pending spinner (`46139694`)
- perf(android): render after input is delivered so scroll frames never repeat (`0d64a723`)
- feat(discover): label search sections with Movies or Series (`c232a1d4`)
- fix(search): retry addon search requests on 5xx and transport errors (`125b43a8`)
- perf(ui): cache theme metrics and stop clon
